value.text: The Nazi looting of books in Austria and their partial restitution

In the NS-era the NB was directed by Paul Heigl, a member of the NSDAP since 1933, of the SS and the SD. He tried to secure as many looted and confiscated books and archives as possible for his institution. In May 1945 he destroyed many documents and committed suicide.
